description: Repository class for managing articles in a database, including CRUD operations, filtering, and related data retrieval.

classes.name: ArticlesRepository
classes.description: Repository class for performing database operations related to articles, including creation, update, deletion, filtering, and fetching articles and related data.

methods.name: create_article
methods.description: Creates a new article with optional tags, and returns the created Article object.

methods.name: update_article
methods.description: Updates an existing article with new data and returns the updated Article object.

methods.name: delete_article
methods.description: Deletes the specified article from the database.

methods.name: filter_articles
methods.description: Filters and retrieves a list of articles based on optional tag, author, favorited user, limit, and offset.

methods.name: get_articles_for_user_feed
methods.description: Retrieves articles for a user's feed based on their following activity.

methods.name: get_article_by_slug
methods.description: Fetches a single article by its slug, raises exception if not found.

methods.name: get_tags_for_article_by_slug
methods.description: Retrieves list of tags associated with an article identified by slug.

methods.name: get_favorites_count_for_article_by_slug
methods.description: Returns the number of favorites for an article identified by slug.

methods.name: is_article_favorited_by_user
methods.description: Checks if a specific user has favorited the article.

methods.name: add_article_into_favorites
methods.description: Adds an article to a user's favorites.

methods.name: remove_article_from_favorites
methods.description: Removes an article from a user's favorites.

methods.name: _get_article_from_db_record
methods.description: Constructs an Article object from a database record, including related profile, tags, and favorites info.

methods.name: _link_article_with_tags
methods.description: Associates tags with an article in the database.
